    The McDonald's
    HUNTR/X (Huntrix) Meal, launched on March 31, 2026, as part of the "KPop Demon Hunters" collaboration, features 10-piece Chicken McNuggets, Ramyeon McShaker Fries, and two special sauces (Hunter Sauce and Demon Sauce). This lunch/dinner meal also includes a medium drink, collectible photo cards, and a Derpy access card. 
    This video provides a first-hand look at the Huntrix meal's components:
    01:12
    Trinh Carreon
    Instagram• Mar 31, 2026
    • Components: The meal includes a 10-piece Chicken McNuggets, Medium Fries, and a Medium Drink.
    • Ramyeon McShaker Fries: These fries include a specialized seasoning bag with soy, garlic, sesame, and spice, inspired by the Netflix film.
    • Sauces: The meal includes Hunter Sauce (a sweet chili mix) and Demon Sauce (a purple-colored, spicy mustard sauce).
    • Collectibles: Every meal includes a set of two "KPop Demon Hunters" photo cards.
    • Availability: The HUNTR/X meal is available for a limited time at participating restaurants, generally from lunch hours onwards, while the Saja Boys meal is designed for breakfast. 
    The meal is part of an "adult Happy Meal" trend, often priced around
